description: This file defines the 'ModuleFilter' class, which implements the javax.servlet.Filter interface to allow modules to plug in custom filters into a web request processing chain in the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ModuleFilter
classes.description: Implements a servlet Filter that allows dynamic addition of module-defined filters in the OpenMRS web platform.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, logging the initialization process.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, logging the destruction process.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each request, invoking module-defined filters in the chain.
